# Introduction

Kvastur is a neutral creature found in The Bog Witch hut. It defends itself if attacked.
It will attack monsters close to the hut.

### Drops

• Item: Kvastur trophy | Chance: 100% | Number: 1

• Item: Wood | Chance: 100% | Number: 1

• Item: Resin | Chance: 100% | Number: 1

## Spawning

A Kvastur is initially present in The Bog Witch hut and respawns one minute after being killed.

### Attack

Slams down on the enemy, hitting 2 meters out in a 90-degree vertical arc (80 Blunt damage). This attack has a 2-second cooldown and can be used within 1.2 meters of an enemy.
